desc: Under the old theory, this pattern was considered good for Black because, had White played at <A:P14> directly, Black could not jump to <B:Q13>. This evaluation has changed significantly. First, as AlphaGo famously demonstrated in Game 1 against Lee Sedol, there is bad aji at <C:R14>. Second, renewed emphasis on the corners means that Black can answer the older joseki at <position: 28689>.
